## FPX Pre-Match Scouting Summary

**Roster note:** Only three players have data in this window. The brief covers one duelist (Setrod), one initiator (KovaQ), and one sentinel (AAAAY), with AAAAY and Setrod both flagged as flex.

---

**Firepower distribution**

The most notable number here: AAAAY, the sentinel/flex player, leads the team in both ACS (226) and rating (1.23) — comfortably ahead of the designated entry fragger Setrod (196 ACS, 0.81 rating). A sentinel out-fragging the duelist by 30 ACS and 0.42 rating points is worth flagging. KovaQ (194 ACS, 0.78 rating) sits just below Setrod, making the bottom two players essentially equal in output.

---

**Player profiles**

**AAAAY** runs a wide agent pool spanning sentinels (Killjoy 22%, Cypher 11%, Vyse 6%), controllers (Viper 28%, Brimstone 6%), and a heal utility pick (Sage 17%), with Veto at 11%. No single agent dominates; his play is genuinely distributed across roles, which is the flex designation in practice.

**Setrod** is more concentrated: Neon (44%) is his primary, with Chamber (33%) and Phoenix (22%) rounding out a pure duelist pool.

**KovaQ** leans heavily on Fade (56%), with Sova, Tejo, and Skye splitting the remainder. Relatively specialist compared to the other two.

---

**Data caveat**

Only three players are profiled. If FPX fields a full five-man roster, two players have no data in this window and should be treated as unknowns.
